response.overview: They have been training in the greatest secrecy for years now, refining questionable dodging techniques and illegal branch blows. After last year's legendary duel, the truce is over. The two competing giants take up arms for the fight of the century. On the program of this blockbuster: Commando training: Handling of dry wooden and four-man tactics. Zero-budget stunts: Missed stick strokes, loss of balance and uncontrollable laughter. The climax: Define once and for all who is the real boss of the stick
response.tagline: Two fighters One staff No mercy
response.title: The Battle of the Stick
